Native Name(s): Common Aliases Found in Stream Tags
Original, Orig, Undetermined, und, VO, Version Originale
2-Letter: The native language the movie was shot in. Sometimes left blank or tagged as und (undetermined) by ripping software. VO (Version Originale) is the standard French naming convention for the original language track.

Native Name(s): Commentary, Comm, Director's Commentary, Cast Commentary
2-Letter: Alternative audio tracks featuring filmmakers or actors talking over the movie.
Audio translated into a secondary language (e.g., "English Dub", "Hindi Dub").

Native Name(s): AD, Audio Description, DVS, Visual Description
2-Letter: Tracks specifically narrated for the visually impaired, describing on-screen actions.
A track featuring only the movie's musical soundtrack with no dialogue or sound effects.

Native Name(s): Lektor, Gavrilov, Voiceover, Voice-Over, Voice Over
2-Letter: Common in Eastern Europe (especially Poland and Russia), where a single narrator translates the dialogue over the original audio.
